description: This file provides a utility function called inferColumns, which takes data rows and an allowlist to generate a column configuration suitable for displaying in a DataTable component. It handles label creation, date field formatting, and allows filtering of fields based on presence in data and an allowlist.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates DataTable column definitions by intersecting the provided data rows with an allowlist, formatting labels and handling date fields appropriately.
